verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents an official MCP server, confirmed by a probe of its docs page. It lets Claude, Cursor, Copilot and other agents query metrics, logs, traces, alerts and dashboards, and manage dashboards, alert rules, saved views and notification channels. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, documented setup/auth/transport details in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and other AI agents to SigNoz via MCP for natural language access to metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.
Use natural language to query metrics, traces, and logs; investigate alerts; and manage dashboards, alert rules, saved views, and notification channels.
